sources.title: Septuaginta — Malachias 3, Deutsche Bibelgesellschaft web text
sources.claim_limit: May support exact observable LXX wording in Malachi 3:1-5: ναός, πῦρ χωνευτηρίου, refining/purifying language, and κρίσις. May not prove literary dependence of 1 Peter.

sources.title: Dennis E. Johnson, Fire in God's House: Imagery from Malachi 3 in Peter's Theology of Suffering
sources.claim_limit: May support article identity and Johnson's accessible methodological framing about context and conscious OT allusion. Detailed later argument is not treated as directly inspected through this route.

sources.title: John Proctor, Fire in God's House: Influence of Malachi 3 in the NT
sources.claim_limit: May support Proctor's explicit summary of Johnson's 1 Peter/Malachi thesis: refining fire in 1:6-7, oikos/temple construal, convergence in 4:12-19, divine presence/purification and judgment moving outward. Full Proctor article beyond the open section remains subscription-blocked.

sources.title: Kelly D. Liebengood, Zechariah 9-14 as the substructure of 1 Peter's eschatological program — St Andrews repository
sources.claim_limit: May support only what the repository abstract explicitly states: Liebengood argues dependence on Zechariah 9-14 for 1 Peter's suffering theology and says this proposal explains fiery trials, 4:14, the 4:12-19 to 5:1-4 transition and oikos tou theou. It is used only to establish a substantive alternative proposal. Detailed thesis-section criticism of Johnson is not card evidence in this wave because screenshot readback of the PDF failed.
sources.rights_note: Repository states items are copyright protected unless otherwise indicated; the PDF is available for personal/research use. No republication claim is made.
